content.user_title: Build Azure AI Search Python Workflows
content.value_statement: Azure AI Search projects need correct SDK patterns for indexing, vector search, and secure authentication. This skill gives focused Python guidance and examples.
actual_capabilities: Shows how to install and import the Azure Search Documents Python SDK.
Explains SearchClient, SearchIndexClient, SearchIndexerClient, and KnowledgeBaseRetrievalClient use cases.
Provides patterns for index creation, vector fields, semantic configuration, and HNSW search.
Covers document upload, merge, delete, buffered batching, and query operations.
Demonstrates keyword, vector, hybrid, semantic, autocomplete, suggest, filter, and facet queries.
Includes guidance for API key authentication and DefaultAzureCredential.
limitations: Does not provision Azure resources or manage cloud permissions by itself.
Requires the user to supply valid endpoints, indexes, credentials, and embedding vectors.
Examples may need updates for specific SDK versions and service features.
Does not validate production schema design, capacity planning, or data privacy requirements.

use_cases.title: Create Search Indexes
use_cases.description: Design an Azure AI Search index with text fields, vector fields, and semantic ranking configuration.

use_cases.title: Add Retrieval To Applications
use_cases.description: Implement keyword, vector, hybrid, and semantic queries for a Python application using SearchClient.

use_cases.title: Prepare AI Search Pipelines
use_cases.description: Use indexers, skillsets, data sources, and knowledge base patterns for enriched search workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Start A Search Client
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a Python project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a Python Azure AI Search client using environment variables and DefaultAzureCredential.

prompt_templates.title: Design A Vector Index
prompt_templates.scenario: Create an index for semantic and vector retrieval.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an Azure AI Search Python index with content fields, a vector field, HNSW configuration, and semantic ranking.

prompt_templates.title: Build Hybrid Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Show how to run a hybrid Azure AI Search query in Python with keyword text, a vector query, filters, and selected fields.

prompt_templates.title: Review Retrieval Architecture
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced design review for production search.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my planned Azure AI Search Python workflow for indexing, batching, semantic ranking, agentic retrieval, and credential handling.

output_examples.input: User asks for a new vector-enabled product catalog index.
output_examples.output: A field plan, vector profile guidance, semantic configuration notes, and a Python implementation outline.

output_examples.input: User asks how to improve search relevance for support articles.
output_examples.output: A hybrid search approach with semantic ranking, filters, selected fields, and result handling recommendations.

output_examples.input: User asks how to upload many documents safely.
output_examples.output: A batching strategy using buffered sending, retry-aware operations, credential guidance, and validation steps.

best_practices: Prefer DefaultAzureCredential for production authentication when the environment supports it.
Match vector dimensions to the embedding model before creating the index.
Use batching and explicit field selection to control cost, latency, and result size.
anti_patterns: Do not hardcode real API keys, endpoints, or connection strings in application code.
Do not create vector fields with dimensions that differ from stored embeddings.
Do not rely only on vector search when keyword and semantic ranking improve relevance.

faq.question: What package does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers the Azure Search Documents SDK for Python, including clients, indexes, documents, and query patterns.

faq.question: Can it help with vector search?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes vector field setup, HNSW configuration, vector queries, and hybrid search guidance.

faq.question: Does it support semantic ranking?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows semantic configuration patterns and query options for captions and ranked results.

faq.question: Does it manage Azure credentials?
faq.answer: No. It explains credential patterns, but users must configure Azure identity, keys, and permissions.

faq.question: Can it create indexes automatically?
faq.answer: It can help write Python code for index creation, but execution depends on user permissions and environment setup.

faq.question: Is it only for retrieval augmented generation?
faq.answer: No. It also covers general search, document operations, filters, facets, suggestions, and indexer workflows.
